notes.title: Patch v1.1.2 — Darius Behaves & Words Make Sense
notes.content:
Hey Hunters! 🎯👻

Today’s update is a small one, but it should make your hunts a lot smoother (and a little less crash-y 😅).
⚙️ What’s Fixed in v1.1.2:
💥 Darius + Gunpowder crash fixed: he can now blast away without taking the whole game with him.

🌍 Localization fixes: some phrases were a little… cursed. They’ve been properly exorcised.

That’s it for today’s bug-zapping! Keep sending us your reports, ideas, and memes. They help us keep the hunt strong (and hilarious).

Stay sharp, stay spooky,
— The Boogey Hunters Team

notes.title: Major Update — New Hunter, New Boogey, New Bullets!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters! 🔫👻

This isn’t just a patch, this is a full-on arsenal upgrade. We’ve packed this update with fresh content, shiny visuals, and some much-needed cleanup in the leaderboards. Buckle up, ‘cause here’s what’s new:
🌟 What’s New in This Update:
🧑‍🎯 A brand-new Hunter joins the roster: more style, more strategies, more chaos.

👹 A new Boogey appears: stronger, creepier, and ready to ruin your day (in the best way).

💥 New bullets added: experiment, combo, and discover broken synergies before we inevitably nerf them. 😉

🎨 Visual refresh: Yelena animations and some user interfaces cleaner, sharper, and prettier than ever.

🚫 Cheaters yeeted from the leaderboard: only true Hunters remain on top.

This is just the beginning of a new era for Boogey Hunters. With more content, more updates, and more mythical chaos on the horizon, the hunt has never been better.

So grab your deck, load your bullets, and show the Boogeys who runs this world. 🌍💀

Stay bold, stay spooky,
— The Boogey Hunters Team

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278986/63e8d75b0a22bb6849f29181f91cbe76ad6be16f.png"]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.6 — Leaderboard Glows, Save Woes and Harold Shows
notes.content:
Greetings, Hunters! 🧢💼

Another day, another round of bug squashing! While you were out bravely battling Boogeys, we’ve been back at HQ cleaning up code, calming down bosses, and giving our leaderboard a much-needed glow-up. 🌟


What’s Fixed in v1.0.6:
🏆 Leaderboard visual update — now shinier, cleaner, and way easier on the eyes. Go chase that top spot in style!

💾 Save bugs fixed — no more spooky surprises when trying to load your progress. Your hunts are now safely tucked in.

🐉 Harold of Lycia encounter fixed & rebalanced — Harold was acting up… again. We had a long talk with him.



Thank you for all your support, bug reports, and memes (seriously, we see them and we love them).
As always — stay bold, stay weird, and keep those Boogeys running scared.

With appreciation and a fresh cup of bug spray,
— The Boogey Hunters Team

notes.title: Patch v1.0.5 — Boogeypedia, Buses & Better Battles
notes.content:
Hey there, fearless Hunters! 🏹👻

We’re back with another fresh patch — v1.0.5 — straight from the bug-zapping van. This one’s got fixes from all corners of the world (literally) and a few quality-of-life boosts that should make your hunts smoother, cleaner, and slightly less cursed. 💫
🛠️ Here’s What’s Cookin’ in 1.0.5:
🚚 "Expresso Truck" encounter bug squashed & rebalanced — the truck no longer drives into the void

🖥️ 16:10 screen ratio fix — battle UI will no longer spill into the unknown. Clean edges = happy hunters.

📖 Boogeypedia Page 2 is fixed — no more getting trapped in the ghostly archives. Flip freely, knowledge seekers!

🌏 Asian language fixes 

We’re loving all your feedback, bug reports, and hilarious battle screenshots. Keep 'em coming! The Boogeys won’t hunt themselves — and we’re just getting started. 😎

Thanks for sticking with us through the weird, the wild, and the wonderfully broken.
Stay sharp, stay spooky.

With admiration and many hotfixes,
— The Boogey Hunters Team

notes.title: Day 2 Update — Bug Fixes, Nerfs & Chaos Control
notes.content:
Hey Hunters! 👻🔫

It’s Day 2 out in the wild, and let’s just say… things got a little too spicy.
Some of you were speed-phasing through monsters like time didn’t exist, and others discovered bullet combos so powerful they probably violated interdimensional law. 🌀💥

So we stepped in. Gently. With patch notes. 😇
⚙️ What’s New in the Day 2 Update:
🐌 Phase transition speed has been nerfed — slow down there, turbo boogeys. Let the hunters breathe.

💣 "Breaking The Law" + "Madness" bullet combo has been fixed — the chaos was fun while it lasted.

🖥️ Full Screen & Resolution settings fixed — your screen is now legally obligated to behave.

📸 Westwood ending photo fixed — it now actually shows the correct memory. Smile!

🏆 Leaderboard now works for both characters — no more favoritism.

🌍 Localization tweaks — we fixed a few translation hiccups, so things should make a bit more sense now (we hope!).

We’re keeping a close eye on all the awesome (and occasionally cursed) things you’re discovering, and more updates are on the way. Keep the feedback, screenshots, and theories coming — we love ‘em all!

Thanks for playing, breaking things, and helping us fix them.
You guys are the real Boogey busters. 💪💀

Until tomorrow,
The Boogey Hunters Team

notes.title: Boogey Hunters First Day Update
notes.content:
Hey there, Hunters! 🧢🦴

What an incredible first day it's been! We’re beyond grateful for everyone who jumped into Boogey Hunters, explored the forests, chased down mythical creatures, and tested their skills against the unknown.

Thanks to your amazing support, we've gathered tons of feedback, bug reports, and kind words—and we’re already rolling out our First Day Update to make the experience even smoother.
🔧 Patch Notes — v1.0.1
Fixed an issue of game victory.

Fixed an issue where Hexed Ammunition debuff.

Tweaked balancing for Baba Yaga phase 3.

Typo and localization fixes.

And yes—we’ve seen your ideas. Some of them are just brilliant. We’re already planning some exciting features for future updates (did someone say more Boogeys from around the world? 👀).
💬 Keep Talking to Us!
Your feedback is gold. Join the conversation, share your best moments, or tell us what made you rage-quit (it’s okay, we’ve been there too). Every message helps us make Boogey Hunters even better.

From all of us on the team — thank you for hunting with us. The journey has just begun. 🏹🌎

Stay brave,
The Boogey Hunters Team
